notes: Critic fix: I took the S1 Skyport station at (530,0) off the list. The plan has no walkable public space there. The quay ends at x 385 (pier 330–385, y ±25), and everything from x 330 to 740 is water. No road or foot path can serve as its `fronts`. I will not hand over an entrance the cell cannot reach.

No legal Skyport position exists on the current plan. A station on the pier (x ≤ 385) would need Harbour at x ≤ 185 to keep the 200 m S-S2 minimum. Circus at 95 then forces Harbour to x ≥ 295. Both cannot hold. Dropping Harbour would break the T2/parade interchange naming and the Harbour Road entrance. So S1 now has three stations on-sheet: Gardens −160, Circus 95, Harbour 320. Gaps are 255 and 225 m.

For Datum (blocking): the airport line has no airport station. Please add skyport land (an island or apron inside the loop) and a forecourt or foot path joined by walkable ground (a pier or bridge from the quay). Put that path on S1's straight trunk between x 520 and 560, or extend the trunk. I will then place Skyport there with length 50 and `fronts` set to the new path id, and rerun N-P2 and W-1. Aster: this is also a design gap for Sky, because the plan concept says S1 is the airport line.
Harbour station at (320,0) stands over the quay strip (x 312–330), which is walkable. Its platform runs from x 295 to 345, and its entrance opens onto Harbour Road. That is 12 m from T2 Parade Quay.

All other stops are unchanged from my last proposal. These are still hand figures and have not been run through the checker: I have no shell. Reach is tightest at crown-terraces (about 247 m from Gardens) and crescent-north (about 247 m from S1 Circus). No plots lie over water, so dropping Skyport does not change N-R1. The next owner should run `bun tools/plan/cli.ts` and send me the output.

Still open: Splice/Keel need to confirm the T1/T2 flat crossing at Market × Boulevard. Waymark needs to decide on seal points at the precinct gates; I placed no T2 stop there. Aster should update the concept note's 'one interchange'.
